text: 各位好，我是摩根士丹利台灣醫藥健康分析師 Jaclyn。今天的說明會將以英文及中文雙語進行。保瑞管理層將與各位分享第三季度的營運表現以及未來業務展望。問答環節將以中英文雙語進行。

Good afternoon everyone. Thank you for joining today's Bora Pharmaceuticals third quarter 2026 earnings call. This is Jaclyn, China Biotech and Taiwan Healthcare Analyst at Morgan Stanley. Today's call will be conducted in both English and Mandarin, with management walking us through the third quarter results this year and business outlook, followed by a Q&A session in both languages.

在會議開始前簡單提示，本次電話會議僅面向摩根士丹利客戶，並不面向媒體成員。如果您是媒體成員，請另行與我們聯繫。有關重要披露，請參閱 www.morganstanley.com/researchdisclosures。本會議將分為兩個部分，首先由管理層進行業績報告，其後進入問答環節。Before I begin, please note this call is intended for Morgan Stanley clients and not for members of the press. If you are a member of the press, please reach out separately. For important disclosures, please see www.morganstanley.com/researchdisclosures. We'll begin today's call with the prepared remarks from the management followed by a Q&A session.

今天我們很高興邀請到保瑞管理層與大家分享第三季度的營運表現以及未來展望。今天出席會議的管理層包括董事長及執行長 Bobby Shen，財務長 Alice Wang，以及資深投資人關係經理 Nadia Chen。We are very pleased to have the management team with us today to discuss third quarter performance and the business outlook. Joining us today are Bobby Shen, Chairman and CEO; Alice Wang, CFO; Nadia Chen, Senior Investor Relations Manager.
那麼接下來我先把時間交給 Alice 總，請開始今天的分享。With that, I'll turn the call over to Alice to begin with the prepared remarks. Alice, please go ahead.
各位投資先進大家好，我是保瑞集團的財務長 Alice。那今天由我先跟大家分享第三季度的營運成果。那是今天的免責聲明請各位參閱。接下來我們可以看到保瑞集團的營運規模與全球佈局。我們的 CDMO 已經是全台灣最大的藥品製造商，在全球已有 10 個生產基地，有 2000 多個員工，分佈在 3 個大洲。那保瑞集團是可以做從研發開發、劑型開發到商業化量產...
Hey, sorry to interrupt. Your audio is breaking in between. Alice, 你的 microphone 的接收好像有點太敏感，所以好像有一點斷斷續續的。
在美國的佈局我們有馬里蘭的針劑廠以及明尼蘇達的口服廠，在加拿大有密西沙加廠。那這是我們在全球佈局的 10 個生產基地的一個概況。
接下來可以看到保瑞集團在 2026 年第三季度的重要業務進展。在財報，我們在上一季承諾的下半年的進展大都多已經達成。在 CDMO 的部分可以看到我們訂單，專案與品牌藥、學名藥表現也已經回溫。那子公司泰福併購威德、保瑞生醫併購保瑞藥業的國際成績。那接下來我們在之前法說會介紹過泰福生醫，那時候的重點是泰福併購威德，貢獻營收部分有體現。泰福與保瑞併購後，也希望 CDMO 之後能有更好的發展。
Hey, sorry to interrupt. Sorry, sorry to cut you. Your audio is breaking in between. Could you please turn off your video and just speak? Alice, video 要不要關掉試試看？

If we still break up, maybe Bobby can you take over? Because everything seems fine at our end. It's okay now. It's okay now. Okay, so 我們可以看到這一季我們的獲利成長性，本季是賺贏上一季的，延續第二季的動能。季營收季增新台幣 5.64 億，營業利益季增新台幣 1.04 億。CDMO 事業規模逐漸擴大，CDMO 自製產能季增 16%，為 2025 年以來季對季最大的增幅。
營收新台幣 20.85 億，年增 16.9%，季減 1.5%。全球銷售業務加速成長，單季營收新台幣 33.02 億元，年增 9.3%，季增 12.5%。受惠於合併產品線表現優於管理層預期，以及 Upsher-Smith 的綜效。2027 年起，中期能見度為歷年來最高，未來 12 個月在手訂單達 3.4 億美元，北美各場能見度充足。
現在我們重要的里程碑可以看到有四個項目。一個是 CDMO 新接的訂單，奠定中期商業化的基礎。今年累計新案金額達到 4.36 億美元，主要來自於年中時公告的大藥廠多年期商業化合約，以及持續深化的臨床與品牌藥專案組合。羅福廠與前 20 大藥廠簽訂 10 年長約，相關技術以及移轉持續進行中，並分階段投入資本支出以及資源增長。

那在馬里蘭針劑廠，為我們的產能準備。馬里蘭針劑廠 Aseptic 的隔離器技術建置順利進行中，新的 Aseptic 產能已完成 4 批的試產驗證（PV），第 5 項技術移轉案預計在 2027 年進行。那在全球銷售的部分，季增雙位數，全球銷售業務為集團的支柱。營收季增 19.3%，年增 12.2%。專案品牌藥較 2025 年平均單季水準成長 14%，受惠於合併產品線的持續逐季成長，提高品牌藥的獲利貢獻。
Upsher-Smith 的綜效，Upsher-Smith 學名藥維持市場的領導地位。在我們今年進行的兩個併購整合也非常成功。Upsher-Smith 與威德完整貢獻一季度，集團綜效計畫啟動。羅福廠物資併入保瑞首季即交付高單價的量產訂單。威德 Global Nutrition 併入保瑞，未來首個季度即成為集團顯著的獲利來源。
那下一步看到財報的部分。我們的美國自營學名藥與專案品牌藥獲利將隨著架動率的優化而逐步的擴張。第三季的營收是 4.5 億... 第三季營收 4.5 億，QoQ 成長 9.6%，YoY 成長 34.3%。營業毛利的部分是 25.29 億，QoQ 成長 4.1%，YoY 成長 16.5%。毛利率 39%，跟第二季的 41% 還有優化空間。
營業利益的部分是 10.09 億，較第二季的 9.87 億增加了 1.04 億，季增 10.5%，年增 20%。在本期淨利的部分，6.54 億，季增 9.5%，年增 20%。EPS 是 4.79 元，季增 9.9%。年減是因為去年有一次性的利益，所以在 EPS 部分跟去年拿掉一次性的利益還是有成長的。排除兩季度中的一次性或相關費用，營業利益實際季增新台幣 1.4 億元。

馬里蘭針劑廠 2026 年受法規變動影響表現不如預期，部分在手訂單會遞延到 2027 年逐步。分析企業泰福生技 2026 年損益反映轉型的相關措施，包括剩餘試藥、設備部分的減損。那我們目前非常 focus 在未來的成長動能。兩個關鍵的專案是完成馬里蘭針劑廠隔離產線轉換，確保批次生產不中斷，逐量交付，重拾營收與獲利動能。整合羅福與 San Diego 廠，共 2 萬公升一次性生物製劑原料產能，以及竹北開發能量，打造單一生物製劑 CDMO 的平台。

Bobby, it's your turn. 希望這個接觸比較好。Jack, thumbs up? Okay. Little better. 好，謝謝財務長。雖然這個電腦上好像今天都會出一些小小的狀況，但其實數字是很精彩。那接下來我就用英文解釋整個事業體的一些 Q3 的表現。So, I'll speak in English for the remaining of the top of the Q3 earnings report. For the CDMO, we still, some of the highlights, we still continue to see strong growth in sales and new molecules.

In the last two years of acquisitions, we've invested 55 million in capital, especially for our North America facilities, and it's allowed us to focus on specialized capabilities for each of the sites, especially for our Maple Grove facility that is focused on controlled substance and also the expansion of our biologics capability in Rockville, Maryland. Our new signings are very exciting. We're expected to bring 24 new molecules into Bora network as of Q3, including three NCEs, spanning from clinical trial all the way to registration, adding to the 110 molecules within the Bora manufacturing process this quarter.

12-month rolling backlog stood firm at 340 million till the end of Q3 2026, reflecting the timing of the conversion of the Maryland injectable facility as we are ramping that back up and into the isolator lines, which I'll talk about a little later. YTD CDMO wins have reached a new high as we stated, actually had a new high since last quarter. We continue to drive new sales into the sites and into the business, especially with our multi-year commercial agreements in our largest facility in North America, and that is the Maple Grove facility. We have clear visibility from the 12-month backlog into actually a reoccurring five-year commercial supply for a lot of our sites.

...biologics CDMO side of the business to scale. Right now, we see a 12-month rolling backlog of 50 million US dollars already into that facility alone. The eight batches we produced in Q3 alone is very, very close and will exceed for the rest of the year the 13 that was produced in 2025. So, it's an impressive quarter for the facility and a great start for the facility as well.

We're expecting to realize and continue to realize a lot of the synergies that we have with that facility and the Tanvex facility in San Diego and the Bora Biologics Zhubei facility in Taiwan. We're one of the few facilities that has an end-to-end from cell line development all the way to commercial product drug substance and to drug product in our fill and finish facility in Baltimore. So that's really and a majority of that happens within North America.

So that's really producing a lot of demand and a lot of inquiries for manufacturing within North America and a biologic facility that does an end-to-end all within North America. We also have our first year of revenues and earnings for that facility and if you take out one-time expenses, we are already cash flow positive in that facility. So some really good milestones for the biologics acquisition that we've just acquired.

Okay, and then in the outlook for 2027, we split our sites into the more mature sites and our high-growth facilities. Our scaled-up maturing facilities continue to see actually a lot of benefit from once we get to scale, we actually start specializing them in their particular niches, especially now like the Canadian facility is focused more on semi-solids and liquids and our Zhunan facility is really benefiting from its high potency and hormone manufacturing capabilities.

And we'll continue to do that and rationalize the products that are in those facilities and increase the gross margin in those facilities as well. We also have intensified our efforts, marketing efforts and sales efforts for this onshore tailwind that we have. US CDMO business is positioned very well to capture domestic commercial demand and orders and we continue to see momentum in our mature facilities in Canada and Zhunan as well.

As for the future, the Maple Grove still continues to grow. We still continue to see large pharma and innovative small pharma fill that facility. We are continuing the contract we signed in Q2 and onboarding that company and those products into the facility, which we will see start to mature and start to show sizable revenues in the end of 2027 and into 28.

The Bora Biologics network, of course, that we just explained before, is realizing a lot of the synergies because of our three sites and our fill and finish capabilities right down the street from Rockville in Baltimore. Finally, the Maryland injectable facility, we are seeing strong 12-month backlog. That backlog is especially being built up as we are transferring a lot of our clients from the RABS technology into the isolator technology, which is taking about a quarter or two and will boost margins and boost productivity.

A little bit of insight onto the type of CapEx we're investing into our facilities. Like I was saying before, as our sites, some of our sites get to scalability, we continue to invest in differentiating our capabilities. For example, our oral solid dose, we are focusing more on controlled substance and the controlled substance management and safety of the controlled substance sites, also high potency, hormone, as well as oncology-related high potency type products.

On the non-sterile liquids, we're focusing like oral nano-suspension, nebulizer technology, sterile fill and finish. Obviously, the big move into isolator-enabled technology per a lot of guidance with the FDA and the trends, we are leading that trend and we are going above and beyond what the FDA is asking for and we are all-in on the isolator technology, especially liquids and lyophilization vials, pre-filled syringe.

Of course, we want to really focus on the small to mid-volume as the capabilities of biologics and the titer and the yield rates go up. We realize that the small to mid-volume range is a great range to be in and we're doing very well as we can see with our backlog. Obviously, focusing more on semi-solids with our scalability in our Canadian facility and finally once again rounding out our capabilities in biologics and really leaning into getting to scale and getting to a sizable amount of representation of biologics into our facility.

So going from a non-sterile environment all the way to a full sterile biologics facility, that really is increasing our capabilities and increasing our presence into the CDMO landscape and becoming a real important player and partner in the CDMO space. Next page. A little bit of insight into our pharma sales business. Our pharma sales business has seen exceptional, exceptional growth quarter over quarter in the last 18 months as you guys can probably see.

It is, as Alice, our CFO, showed in one of the slides, it has outpaced our CDMO growth of the business with really great management, really great products, and seeing sustainable manufacturing capabilities and sustainable supply because of our strong CDMO presence. That synergy is really coming to fruition as you can see our revenues has increased quarter over quarter and year over year, arriving at 3.3 billion in Q3 alone.

And it's the first quarter that both quarter over quarter and YOY have seen growth since 2025. So that is definitely getting back on track after our product rationalization we did towards the end of last year and we definitely see that trending up as you can see in the first half of 2026. We highlighted that our specialty pharma business was exceeding our generic business, but generic business has rebounded strong with our strong defense of our key products, our key high-margin products.

And so that has started to come back in a very strong way. But we're seeing both growth in specialty and high-value generics. A little bit of insight into our lead product, Biga-fied. We continue to see revenue growth. In nine months, our 2026 revenues has already exceeded and matched our 2025 fiscal year, the whole year. Q3 represents our seventh straight quarter over quarter growth for the Biga-fied franchise.

And that is a really strong franchise that we still continue to see growth in not only this quarter but also the following quarters. And we continue to defend and also maximize our high-margin generic products. And obviously, as I stated before, we are seeing stabilization and re-growth in that generic space. And a little bit of insight into our Sunway Biotech business. As you know, that originally was a spin-off of our legacy business in consumer health and some in-licensing.

Merging that in with Sunway, Sunway's recently acquired Weider Global. We reinvested into Sunway Biotech and now we represent 42% of Sunway. And the acquisition of Weider Global now has really catapulted that company and that brand into being an important part, as you can see now it's like 17% of our revenues and that has become an important part of the Bora Group. So we want to give you a little insight on the exciting things that are happening with that division.

And how they're growing that division with Weider Global Health. Now the consumer healthcare division focuses on longevity with nutrition with direct-to-consumer expansion in Europe and also in the United States. It'll be really that Weider brand is now becoming the backbone of that business and becoming a global brand name. We're growing 36% quarter over quarter since the acquisition, seeing brand scale, rapid profits. Net income for the first nine months of 2026 has already reached 22 times last year's net income.

So definitely that pace is exciting. That brand is growing and we're definitely seeing once again the synergies from Sunway's R&D, Bora's management and lean management and operational efficiency included as a backbone in manufacturing with the global Weider brand name. So once again, the Bora Group is providing an infrastructure of management, manufacturing, R&D capabilities and expanding on these companies that are now becoming much more involved in our total what we call the Bora Group revenue base.

A little sneak peek into our 2027 growth and our potential and our outlook. We really have seen a comeback and sustainability within our CDMO business. We see that site utilization as it trends upwards, we're going to continue to see increases in gross margin. We're continuing to increase utilization, especially in our Maple Grove facility. With our specialty pharma business, as you can see that's a quarter over quarter over growth.

We still see continued growth and not just the Biga-fied products but all the specialty brands within that business and also continued sustainability within the generics business. We've made a lot of investments in the last two years in our biologics and now we are starting to see the biologics impact and as you can see the story is coming together with our investments in the early stage in our cell line development going into our commercial production and then having a fill and finish all within the North America network.

So we are going to see the synergistic values of that and we're going to see a lot of those returns come within the next couple of years. Finally, once again, I mentioned the CHC business. We're going to be the first business in Taiwan that has a global brand consumer business based on backed by real science within the Bora network and also strong, strong, strong manufacturing capabilities that will give it its uniqueness and specialization within a very crowded field but also a very fast-paced, fast-growing business as the aging population spending power gets much more active and much more powerful within the global ecosystem.
Alright, thank you very much.

謝謝 Bobby，謝謝 Alice 的分享。那我們現在進入問答環節。那進入問答環節前先簡單提醒大家，可以透過 Q&A 文字框提交問題。英文或中文提問皆可，我們會按照收到問題的順序安排，再由管理層依序回覆。Thank you Bobby and Alice for the presentation. And before we move into the Q&A, just a quick reminder for listeners on this webcast that questions can be submitted through the Q&A text box. Questions may be submitted either in English or Mandarin, we'll take the questions in the order that they are received and management team will address them accordingly.
So with that, let me start with the first questions on the line. 第一個問題問到的是，有投資者想請問，就是保瑞在近期有再次協助這個泰福的資金需求，也近期看到比較多的人事異動。那第三季度可能有一些相關生物相似藥設備的減損，然後可能也有一些近期增資多次，想了解一下未來對這個泰福公司的具體計劃是如何？

So we've seen that Bora has supported Tanvex on funds and have seen numerous management team shifts, and in third quarter had some equipment-related depreciation, there has been several raises of fundraising. So just wondering about what the outlook and the plan the company has for Tanvex.
Should I reply in English or Chinese? 可能兩個。I think maybe both.
我先用英文講，可能剛才他是用中文問對不對？對，一開始就是問中文。好，那其實大方向我們還是非常非常看好泰福。那泰福你也知道，它有很長久的歷史，那其實這個歷史來說呢，我們一直不斷地在整理它，一直不斷地在整合它。那我買了我們的 Rockville 廠之後呢，其實就可以有很多機會去讓他們兩個 synergy 可以看到那邊的費用可以再降低。
所以你看一些人事的變動是因為我們現在有這個 Rockville facility，那可以展現一個更大的一個開源節流的計劃。那其實我們還是非常看好我們最近投資 San Diego 這個 2000 liter。那兩個 2000 liter 現在就是要希望有客戶可以盡快用到。那我們現在開發端呢其實有很多的客戶，那要等的開發端要到可以到成熟到讓產品通過，甚至到一個大量生產的。

其實還是要等一段時間，但我們認為說其實這個等時間到了的時候呢，它會有更大的一個投資效益出來。那短線來說呢，我們還是用一個我們台灣的方式，用一個開源節流，讓它更有效益。那其實這看起來他們的財報呢，其實會越來越穩定。那保瑞是百分之百支持現在泰福的大方向，包括現在泰福的領導團隊，也是我們原本的保瑞生技的廠長，我們升到總經理。然後現在這個不管是廠的管理、財務管理等等，再接上很多的泰福的細節，我們沒有在這個會議有報告，但它以新客戶來說呢，也簽到一些也創造一個新高。所以其實它的新客戶這樣簽下來，但大分子說實話是要是一個比較大的投資，所以為什麼我們覺得說泰福是一個很好的一個一個一個 entity，是可以再做比較大的募資，然後它的時間也必須要拉長，但它的整個未來性，其實如果大家要了解為什麼我們那麼看好大分子，大分子的成長率大概現在市場上是 20% 到 30%，那一般的小分子 CDMO 是成長 7% 到 8%，所以幾乎是一個三倍的成長率的增加。那為什麼？其實因為現在很多開發藥都是用 biologics 大分子來開發出來的，不管是 ADC、AOC、bispecific、trispecific，其實這些所謂的標靶藥都是用大分子來開發的。那你可以看所有的新藥通過的呢都是大分子，所以我們認為說這個是 CDMO 必須要有的，那必須要做的投資，這個也是我們為什麼一直非常支持泰福這個 entity，然後把這個 Orion 的部分也再加進去。
謝謝。我補充一下，就是針對董座剛提的，在個調整計畫做完之後呢，預計 2027 年 San Diego 廠能夠減少四分之三的現金流出，也就是大概美金 1000 多萬的現金流出。那這些調整都是著眼於他們能夠全新投入在 CDMO 的業務。那剛剛您有提到就是保瑞也是泰福的股東之一，針對股本的結構呢，我們相信泰福經營團隊跟董事會會以兼顧所有股東權益的角度來設計它的股本結構。謝謝。
